sources.tags: AS: the tags the farm's buyer and supply rules classify on (farming_sim data/farm/buyers.json, supply.json); an exported feature carries ALL its tags, so a rule change in the farm needs no re-export unless it names a new tag
sources.name_words: AS: the farm's merchant_names list; a feature with a name containing one is exported even without a listed tag
sources.industrial_land: AS: land a procedural site may stand on; road_mm = distance to the nearest highway=* way vertex of the same tile
